QuestInfo.name: In the Queen's Absence
QuestInfo.0: You've arrived in Elluel. Talk to Philius, the Elder of Magic.
QuestInfo.1: Philius says you're welcome to wait until Mercedes returns from wherever she went. \r\nHe asks you to keep a child named Moonie company while you wait.
QuestInfo.2: You find Moonie, the only non-frozen kid in the entire kingdom.

0.0: I regret to inform you that she is away. You're welcome to wait, though I'm uncertain when she'll return.
0.1: While you wait, #h0#, would you mind granting me a boon?

yes.0: As you see, many of my gentle brethren in Elluel still slumber, unable to break the Black Mage's curse.
yes.1: The other elders and I are free, but we have much to attend to. We try to make time to play with #bMoonie#k, but I'm afraid the child spends most of the day alone. Will you play with him?

no.0: In case you didn't understand what I said, I asked if you could do me a favor... But I asked it all elf-like.

1.0: Are you REALLY going to play with me?!

yes.0: Oh, wow! Wow, wow, wow! Will you tell me a story? Will you tell me TEN stories?! Use sound effects!

npc.0: Moonie plays alone just below where we stand. Please, play with him.
